entities.name: Genoa–Ventimiglia railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Genova-Ventimiglia railway runs along the coast of the Liguria region of Italy. It was opened as a single track line between Genova and Savona in 1868, and between Savona and Ventimiglia in 1872, mostly running along a coastal corniche.
